svg.text: 1980s ice cream truck · the child that isn’t — contestant vehicle dossier
Decals: the features are slightly wrong
Roof loudspeaker — a warped, slowed jingle
A 1980s ice cream truck, faded patchy pastel
paint, peeling cartoon decals whose features
look slightly wrong, a rooftop loudspeaker, a
frosted-over freezer, rusty and eerie, realistic
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~45k tris · PBR 4K
